/.title: Manav Sahayata Trust | Charity for Tribal Communities in Visakhapatnam
/.description: Since 2004, Manav Sahayata Trust has supported tribal and rural families near Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh with scholarships, medical camps, after-school centers, and essential supplies.

/programs/education.title: Scholarships & Educational Support | Manav Sahayata Trust
/programs/education.description: Scholarships, exam coaching, and mentorship for deserving tribal and rural students in Andhra Pradesh, with a special focus on girls' education. Help a student stay in school.

/programs/bala-vikas.title: Bala Vikas After-School Centers | Manav Sahayata Trust
/programs/bala-vikas.description: Bala Vikas centers give tribal children values education, cultural learning, homework help, and a nutritious meal every day. Support a child's growth.

/programs/medical.title: Medical Camps for Tribal Villages | Manav Sahayata Trust
/programs/medical.description: Free medical camps, medicines, cataract surgeries with Vema Netralaya, and hospital treatment support for tribal families in remote villages of Andhra Pradesh.

/programs/tribal.title: Clothing & Supplies for Tribal Villages | Manav Sahayata Trust
/programs/tribal.description: Warm clothing, blankets, eye camps, and essential supplies for remote tribal villages in Andhra Pradesh, in partnership with Bhagavan Sri Sathya Sai Seva Trust.

/programs/religious-cultural.title: Temple Renovation & Tribal Culture | Manav Sahayata Trust
/programs/religious-cultural.description: 18 Sri Ram temples renovated and a new Hanuman temple built in tribal villages, plus support for Bhajans, Kolatam, and the cultural traditions that bind communities.

/contact.title: Contact Us | Manav Sahayata Trust
/contact.description: Get in touch with Manav Sahayata Trust in Visakhapatnam to donate, volunteer, partner with us, or ask about our programs. Send a message or reach us on WhatsApp.
